_clearinghouse.citation: When quoting a score, include the agent name, overall score and evidence grade, the as-of date (last_reviewed, or as_of for a feed item), and a link to the entry page, e.g. "Aider (open-source): 52/100, evidence grade A, as of 2026-10-17 (Agent Reputation & Trust Clearinghouse, CC BY 4.0, https://www.agentclearinghouse.org/agents/aider.html)". Say that the score is informational and not a guarantee, endorsement, certification or ranking. Do not present directory or feed order as a ranking. More examples: https://www.agentclearinghouse.org/citing.html
_clearinghouse.note: before is null for new entries; values that could not be recovered are null.

items.title: GitHub Copilot CLI: new entry, 51 / B
items.content_text: Added GitHub Copilot CLI (GitHub's terminal coding agent, run with models from several companies; Coding agent): overall 51, evidence grade B, 5 independent performance sources (0 peer-reviewed). Grade B rests on counting a documented hands-on test from a developer blog; without it the grade would be B-, overall 46. Results depend on the model used. Two 2026 advisories fixed on the day they were published (CVE-2026-29783 in 0.0.423 and CVE-2026-45033 in 1.0.43) and two reports that GitHub did not treat as vulnerabilities (an approval bypass and a model-dependent leak of secrets in autopilot mode) are described under disputes. The retired gh copilot extension, GitHub Copilot coding agent, Copilot in IDEs and results for models alone are not covered; studies by Microsoft or GitHub authors are not counted. The coding agents comparison now names GitHub Copilot CLI. Citation check incomplete — recheck later. Informational only. Scores summarize cited public evidence under published rules; they are not a guarantee, endorsement, certification or ranking of quality.

items.title: Gemini CLI (open-source): new entry, 53 / A
items.content_text: Added Gemini CLI (open-source) (Google's open-source terminal coding agent, normally run with Gemini models; Coding agent): overall 53, evidence grade A, 28 independent performance sources (8 peer-reviewed). Grade A rests on a single lower-assurance peer-reviewed study that states a recent version (IJLTER, v0.27.3); without it the grade would be B, overall 51. Results depend on the model used. Google's Tracebit-reported prompt-injection fix (v0.1.14) and two 2026 advisories fixed in 0.39.1 (CVE-2026-12537 and CVE-2026-13745) are described under disputes. Google Jules, Gemini Code Assist and results for Gemini models alone are not covered; studies by Google authors and studies whose authors' own coding product is compared are not counted. The coding agents comparison now names Gemini CLI. Citation check incomplete — recheck later. Informational only. Scores summarize cited public evidence under published rules; they are not a guarantee, endorsement, certification or ranking of quality.

Results depend heavily on the model used. The older, archived Go project also named OpenCode (now Crush) is a different product and is not counted. Three security advisories for OpenCode's local server and web interface (CVE-2026-22812, CVE-2026-22813 and GHSA-632h-h47v-g4x4, which has no CVE) are described under disputes; all were fixed. Anomaly's own material, systems built on OpenCode and studies whose authors' own coding agent or model is compared are not counted. items.title: Google Jules: new entry, 50 / B-
items.content_text: Added Google Jules (Google's asynchronous coding agent that works on a GitHub repository in a cloud virtual machine and returns pull requests; Coding agent): overall 50, evidence grade B-, 3 independent performance sources (none peer-reviewed). No counted source states the Jules version, and all predate the Gemini 3 updates. Google's own posts and benchmark results and a paper by Google authors are not counted; a peer-reviewed study with a GitHub co-author that compares Jules with GitHub Copilot is listed but not counted. One counted study is in a journal whose review process could not be confirmed. An independent researcher's 2025 prompt-injection demonstrations are described under disputes and adherence and are not counted as tests. No CVE, lawsuit or regulatory action concerning Jules was found. The coding agents comparison now names Google Jules among the managed products. Citation check incomplete — recheck later. items.title: Replit Agent: new entry, 51 / B
items.content_text: Added Replit Agent (AI agent in Replit's hosted platform that builds, tests and deploys apps from natural-language requests; Coding agent): overall 51, evidence grade B, 5 independent performance sources (3 peer-reviewed). No counted test states the Agent version. Replit-authored papers and a benchmark co-written by a competing platform are not counted; a security company's test that used its own scanning product is counted with a partial-independence label, and a study funded by a company that sells another prompt-to-app platform (not itself tested) is counted with that disclosure. A user reported in July 2025 that the agent deleted his production database during a code freeze; Replit's CEO acknowledged the report, the user restored the data with Replit's rollback, and Replit then began separating development and production databases. The report is described under disputes and is not counted as a test. No CVE, lawsuit or regulatory action concerning the agent was found. Citation check incomplete — recheck later. Informational only. Scores summarize cited public evidence under published rules; they are not a guarantee, endorsement, certification or ranking of quality.
